title.narrative: Deployment Facility for Peace and Democracy (DFPD). Activites administered by Niras A/S 2023-2027

description.narrative: The Deployment Facility for Peace and Democracy (DFPD) is an instrument that is part of Denmark’s integrated stabilisation engagements around the world. The overall aim of the DFPD is to contribute to stability in fragile countries and contexts by for example providing civil crises response, supporting the rule of law and justice sector, monitoring human rights compliance, building capacity in security forces, police and public institutions, and promoting democracy development through election observation. The DFPD is a Danish stand-by roster comprising approximately 350 civilian experts with a wide range of competencies of relevance to international missions in support of peace and stability in fragile and conflict-affected regions, as well as to the observation of democratic elections around the world. The roster allows deploying civilian experts with relevant competencies in an agile and flexible manner, namely by maintaining experts trained and the roster up-to-date in line with demands in international stabilisation efforts.
